name: @pipeworx/mcp-l2beat

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Rank Ethereum layer 2 networks by Total Value Secured (TVS) in USD, largest first. Answers "which L2 has the most value secured / is the biggest L2", and gives the top-10 leaderboard of rollups, validiums, optimiums and sidechains. Each row returns rank, project name, L2BEAT slug, category (Optimistic Rollup / ZK Rollup / Validium / Other), layer type, host chain, decentralisation stage, tvs_usd, the 7-day TVS change, and the TVS split across native, canonical, external, ether, stablecoin and BTC holdings. Covers every project L2BEAT tracks; use limit to widen the leaderboard.

limit.description: How many top-ranked projects to return (default 25, max 200).

include_archived.description: Set true to also rank projects L2BEAT has archived (default false).

category.description: Keep only one category, e.g. "Optimistic Rollup", "ZK Rollup", "Validium".

include_chart.description: Set true to append the 124-point ecosystem-wide TVS time series (default false).

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Full project record by slug — risks, stage, milestones, contracts.

tools.name: tvs_breakdown
tools.description: Total Value Secured (TVS) breakdown by token category (canonical, external, native) for a specific L2 project slug or all projects; returns today's snapshot from L2BEAT.

tools.name: tvs_history
tools.description: Historical Total Value Secured (TVS) time series for an L2 project or all projects; accepts range (7d/30d/90d/180d/1y/max, default 30d) and optional project slug.

tools.name: activity
tools.description: Daily transaction count (and UOPS where available) time series for an L2 project or all projects; accepts slug and range (7d/30d/90d/180d/1y/max, default 30d) from L2BEAT.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-l2beat forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the l2beat pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
